R7AC-grouse-atv-0001.name: By Small Creek
R7AC-grouse-atv-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7AC-grouse-atv-0001.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Small River FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
14 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 7A table (page 57), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). MU 7-1 is listed in Region 7A on page 2 but no row names it.

plan: Drive: from Village of Valemount, about 44 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 5, Blackman Rd, Hwy 16 (McBride Hwy 16 E), Small River FSR.
Park: 53.07944, -119.55255, where the truck road ends (Small River FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 270 m to the start. Ride: the unnamed road stretch, 3.3 km one way. About 66 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-3, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
